text:
The lecture today will cover a lot of very
important need-to-know content for
the rest of your game design career.

Lots of important details, primarily in the
field of Game Design

Industry-standard practices that are a
must-know.

The field of game design has many factions
to it. We will cover some of them.

Lead Programmer: Who makes all the
executive programming decisions.

Artist: Who can draw pretty neat
stuff.

Level Designer: They can put silly
pieces together.

Music Production: People who make
the funny bleepy bloops.

Marketing: Stupid ad blah blah blah blah.
Boring.

Systems Programming: The
job Kat should probably do.

Ideas Guy: People who can't be
bothered to learn game dev.

Backend: For the people who hate
themselves a lot.

Balancer: For messing around
with numbers without a care.

Storytelling: People with
crazy lore on DeviantArt.

Modeller: For making large
butty characters in the hero
shooter game.

Food Eater: For people who
just show up for the parties.

Learn all the ways to truely show
love to your players.

Fun is what bothers people the
most. You really need to
trim the fat.

This is actually what people
play your games for. Something
with minimal effort!

Oh and also you get loads
of money!!!!!!!

If Counter-Strike can
do it, why can't you?

Creates a supply and demand chain
with major FOMO aspects.

Makes people care about
useless textures

Make your game complete
bullshit and luck based. It'll
increase payments!!

With the increase in RNG concepts, making
pay to win content will mega sell!!

AI has become exceedingly popular
nowadays and is worrying a lot of artists.
Pop the AI bubble now.
